entry.title: New: Resolution 592 (2022-2024) (Hawaiʻi County) — Adopted
entry.content:
AUTHORIZES THE MAYOR TO ENTER INTO AN AGREEMENT WITH THE STATE OF HAWAIʻI DEPARTMENT OF TAXATION

Authorizes the Mayor to enter into a memorandum of agreement to share confidential tax return information relating to the administration of the State and County of Hawaiʻi’s Transient Accommodations Tax.
